steps.say: Click a piece, then where it goes. Start by moving the king's pawn two squares: e2 to e4.
steps.tip: Click the pawn in front of the king, then two squares up.

steps.say: Bring out a knight. Knights jump in an L shape. Move the knight from g1 to f3.
steps.tip: The knight is next to the bishop on the right.

steps.say: Castle to keep your king safe: click the king, then two squares toward the rook.
steps.tip: Click e1, then g1. The rook jumps over.

steps.say: Checkmate wins: the king is attacked and cannot escape. Your queen can do it in one move.
steps.tip: Look at f7, guarded only by the king. Your bishop backs up the queen.
